proposed.text: Before concrete reaches specified strength, what may be placed in embedded pipes under the checked Section 426.8 rule?

options.text: Any gas if the pressure is below the building service pressure.
Only water not exceeding 32 C or 0.35 MPa.
Any liquid if the pipe is coated.
Nothing is ever permitted inside embedded pipes.

rationale.correct: Section 426.8 allows only water not exceeding 32 C or 0.35 MPa before the concrete has attained specified strength.
rationale.takeaway: The checked rule tightly limits pipe contents before concrete reaches specified strength.
